 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Rakesh Kumar

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ram Naresh Ray
 : Mr. Jeetendra Narayan

=
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 420 & 406 of the Indian Penal Code pending in the learned court below.
As per the prosecution case, the informant was a petty contractor of the accused.
After giving the work petitioner has not made payments to the informant, therefore, the present case has been lodged against him.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He further submits that there is business dispute between the parties.

He submits that there is delay of more than three Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.250 of 2023(3)
dt.21-04-2023 years in filing of the present FIR which shows that mala fide intention of the informant.
He further submits that petitioner has got criminal antecedents as stated in para-3 of the bail application.
Learned APP for the State opposes for prayer for bail.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, named above, in the event of his arrest/surrender before the Dilip Narayan vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4185537/
